import sys,json,pathlib,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'wf6-evidence/usage')
from collect_usage import manifest,reconcile_index
from verify_s7 import validate_links
# Importing verify_s7 performs the ordinary read-only link/source audit and regenerates manifest.
E=pathlib.Path('wf6-evidence');assert not reconcile_index(E);checked=validate_links();manifest(E)
m=json.loads((E/'evidence-manifest.json').read_text());assert not m['self_included'];bad=[r['path'] for r in m['files'] if hashlib.sha256((E/r['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=r['sha256']];assert not bad,bad
l=json.loads((E/'usage/usage-ledger.json').read_text());s=l['stages'][7];assert s['status']=='provisional' and s['final_reply_included']==False;print(json.dumps(dict(S7_status=s['status'],S7_usage=s['known_partial_usage'],final_reply_included=s['final_reply_included'],categories=l['categories'],manifest_files=len(m['files']),mismatches=bad,links=checked,index_missing=reconcile_index(E)),ensure_ascii=False))
PY","workdir":"<WORKSPACE>/wf6-rerun-20261014-01","yield_time_ms":1000,"max_output_tokens":200}));
